plugins.hint: Scans plugin.json under plugins/ to manage install, enable, disable and configuration. Install auto-registers missing plugins. After enable/disable, new web requests automatically load plugins with the latest status.
plugins.testHint: Sends a test verification code via SmsSenderInterface. Valid Alibaba Cloud SMS credentials are required.

modules.hint: Scans module.json under modules/ for Starship base modules. Enable/disable writes config files; restart the backend for changes to take effect.
modules.toggleStatusHint: Changing enabled status writes module.json; restart the PHP service for changes to take effect.

themes.hint: Multiple themes can be installed. Only one theme can be active per type (e.g. frontend). Switch enables and activates that theme. Cover images come from each theme's cover file (theme.json cover field). Install auto-registers missing themes.

themes.disableConfirm: Disable theme [{0}]? If it is active, the active flag will be cleared.

themes.empty: No themes found. Add theme.json under themes/ and click Discover Themes.
